description: This file defines models, interfaces, and classes for handling SVG-based SCADA symbols, including metadata parsing, SVG manipulation, animations, and behaviors within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolObject
classes.description: Represents a SCADA symbol with SVG content, behaviors, properties, and animations, managing its lifecycle, rendering, and interactions.

classes.name: CssScadaSymbolAnimations
classes.description: Handles CSS-based animations for SVG elements, including play, pause, stop, finish, and managing animation lifecycle.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolFlowConnectorAnimations
classes.description: Manages animations for flow connectors between SVG elements, including flow appearance and direction.

classes.name: FlowConnectorAnimation
classes.description: Implements animated flow along a path for connectors, supporting play, stop, finish, and appearance customization.

classes.name: CssScadaSymbolAnimation
classes.description: Implements CSS keyframe animations for SVG elements, supporting transforms, styles, looping, and control methods.

classes.name: JsScadaSymbolAnimation
classes.description: Implements JavaScript-based animations for SVG elements, supporting play, pause, stop, speed, and other controls.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolAnimation
classes.description: Interface defining methods for SVG element animations, including control over playback, speed, easing, and transforms.

classes.name: ConnectorScadaSymbolAnimation
classes.description: Interface for connector flow animations, supporting flow appearance, duration, and direction.

methods.name: generateElementId
methods.description: Generates a unique element ID, ensuring it does not start with a digit.

methods.name: applyTbNamespaceToSvgContent
methods.description: Ensures the SVG content has the proper namespace declaration for Thingsboard SVGs.

methods.name: parseScadaSymbolMetadataFromContent
methods.description: Parses SCADA symbol metadata from SVG content, extracting properties and tags.

methods.name: parseScadaSymbolsTagsFromContent
methods.description: Extracts all 'tb:tag' attributes from SVG content.

methods.name: parseScadaSymbolMetadataFromDom
methods.description: Extracts metadata from an SVG DOM document.

methods.name: updateScadaSymbolMetadataInContent
methods.description: Updates SVG content with new metadata.

methods.name: scadaSymbolContentData
methods.description: Extracts root node and inner SVG content, excluding metadata.

methods.name: defaultValueForValueType
methods.description: Provides default values based on ValueType.

methods.name: defaultGetValueSettings
methods.description: Creates default get value settings for a given ValueType.

methods.name: defaultSetValueSettings
methods.description: Creates default set value settings for a given ValueType.

methods.name: updateBehaviorDefaultSettings
methods.description: Sets default behavior settings based on behavior type.

methods.name: defaultScadaSymbolObjectSettings
methods.description: Creates default settings for a SCADA symbol based on its metadata.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Parses and returns error message from exceptions.
